lead: Data stations: plot or read a labour partogram, and read a CTG aloud in a fixed order, then give the diagnosis and the plan.
f: Opened in the active phase at 4 cm: the first X on the alert line · alert line rises 1 cm/h · action line 4 h to the right · the WHO Labour Care Guide (2020) starts the active phase at 5 cm with no lines; local units and exams still use the partograph

Cervix X every 4 h · descent O in fifths palpable · FHR, pulse, contractions every 30 min · liquor I/C/M/B/A · moulding 0 to +3 · contractions as boxes per 10 min: dotted < 20 s, hatched 20–40 s, solid > 40 s · oxytocin and drugs · BP 4-hourly, temperature 2-hourly, urine
Who · fetus · progress (X against the lines, O, contractions) · mother · verdict and plan

sc: Crossing the alert line → Assess the cause; ARM ± oxytocin
Good contractions, no descent, moulding +3 → Obstructed labour: CS

f: Early: head compression, benign · variable: cord compression · late: placental insufficiency · prolonged > 3 min · reduced variability > 50 min is pathological · normal → continue; suspicious → correct causes; pathological → act, consider delivery

sc: FHR below 100 for more than 3 min → Prolonged deceleration: act now
